hypothesis: Spelling out the arrival estimate avoids the observed ETA-to-Ida recognition ambiguity while preserving destination, minutes and action outcome.
scope: Four previously observed development result texts, sixteen Kokoro-to-Parakeet render/transcribe trials in ABBA order. No planner/tool/RTC effect or latency claim.

texts.A: Navigation to Kempegowda International Airport has started. ETA: 88 minutes.
texts.B: Navigation to Kempegowda International Airport has started. Estimated arrival in 88 minutes.

texts.A: Now navigating to Office (Manyata Tech Park), replacing Kempegowda International Airport. ETA: 29 minutes.
texts.B: Now navigating to Office (Manyata Tech Park), replacing Kempegowda International Airport. Estimated arrival in 29 minutes.

texts.A: Added Blue Tokai, Indiranagar as a stop. ETA to MG Road Metro Station: 13 minutes, 0 extra minutes.
texts.B: Added Blue Tokai, Indiranagar as a stop. Estimated time to MG Road Metro Station: 13 minutes, 0 extra minutes.

texts.A: The stop at Blue Tokai, Indiranagar is already on your route. ETA to Office (Manyata Tech Park): 31 minutes.
texts.B: The stop at Blue Tokai, Indiranagar is already on your route. Estimated time to Office (Manyata Tech Park): 31 minutes.

review: Keep all verbatim outputs; review destination/stop/replacement/no-op, duration and estimate wording for each declared text. Do not convert proper-name or number spelling differences into missing facts automatically. No human intelligibility score.
limits: Previously observed development cases, selected to investigate a known acronym issue; not held-out evaluation.
One synthetic voice and production ASR cannot separate pronunciation from recognition error.
ABBA order shares loaded speech models; first cold inference retained; timings descriptive, no population estimates.
No LLM or RTC services during offline comparison; no trimming, retries or transcript-conditioned selection.
Candidate adds one or two spoken words and can change thirty-word fallback coverage. Test existing grounded-summary boundaries separately.
